S.FORM: alang Takamimura ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Laygi go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 233 buwan, 778 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 97% kyan ku 757 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 3% kyan ku 21 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 94%, binah lihuyan s'uli 3%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'zil na Takamimura hya' ga Payljus. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 3 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu
S.PHON: alaŋ takamimura ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu lajɣi ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔzil na takamimura ħjaʔ ɣa pajlju[s|ɕ] reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u
